Re-ran that transform over rtdists 0.12-0's rr98.rda: the accuracy split has 12,205 rows against 12,205 live, and per-item n and per-item mean(resp) reproduce for all 33 items with max |n diff| = 0 and max |mean diff| = 0.00e+00 (i 0: n 110 / acc 0.9545 both sides; i 15: 690 / 0.5029; i 32: 37 / 0.9459). All 33 per-item accuracies are distinct, so every item is separable from every other and no permutation of item_text over items could survive this check. What this does NOT establish: the literal proportion k/32 printed in item_text, which is arithmetic on rr98.Rd's wording rather than a quantity measurable in the response data.
